newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash gains and oils rise with Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash gains and oils rise with Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash grain and oilseed prices were pushed higher once more Tuesday by sharp price rises in Chigaco on hot, dry U.S. weather forecasts, dealers said.
In busy trading on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, cash wheat was up $1-2 a tonne and January rose $4 a tonne, while maize was also $1-2 ahead on the day.
Soybeans showed sharp gains of $3 a tonne and sunseed was quietly ahead about $1 a tonne.
